System Requirements Specification

This document is authored prose interleaved with live query blocks (High-Level Design §4.3a) — it stores only the queries below, never a copy of the entities they resolve. Editing REQ-0001 anywhere in the repository updates what this document renders next time it's generated, with nothing to keep in sync by hand.

Scope

This specification covers the closed-loop stimulation control requirements for the NeuroPulse system, decomposed from the user needs in USR-0001 and USR-0002.

Requirements

All approved requirements, in author-assigned order:

REQ-0001 Closed-loop amplitude adjustment

approved · verified by test

The system shall automatically adjust stimulation amplitude within a pre-configured safe range, using the measured evoked neural response as feedback, without requiring clinician intervention.

Implements

  • USR-0001: Reduced need for in-clinic titration visits

Verified by

  • VER-0001: Bench verification of closed-loop amplitude adjustment

REQ-0002 Single-fault amplitude ceiling

approved · verified by test, analysis

The system shall not deliver a stimulation amplitude exceeding 8 mA under any single-fault condition, including loss of the sense-electrode feedback signal used by the closed-loop control algorithm (DES-0001).

Implements

  • USR-0002: No unexpected increases in stimulation intensity

Verified by

  • VER-0002: Bench verification of single-fault amplitude ceiling

Refined by

  • REQ-0003: Amplitude ceiling — subsystem allocation

Amplitude Ceiling — Subsystem Detail

The system-level ceiling is Single-fault amplitude ceiling, allocated to the subsystem level as an independent hardware safeguard:

REQ-0003 Amplitude ceiling — subsystem allocation

draft · refines REQ-0002 · verified by inspection, test

The pulse-generator ASIC shall enforce a hard current-limit circuit, independent of firmware, as the subsystem-level implementation of the system-level ceiling in REQ-0002.

Implements

No user need linked.

Verified by

Not yet verified.
